records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: Snack Rank is a new growth system for streamers to engage with their viewers and also enjoy the healthy competition with other streamers in the same rank. Streamers can get higher hourly wage and achievement scores as their Snack Rank is increased.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: Based on the Snacks the streamer receives on the day, they will either compete with other streamers or meet the minimum Snack threshold to get the Rank Point. By achieving +2 Rank Points to rank up and hitting -3 Rank Points will rank down.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
As a streamer, encourage your viewers to stay with you for a longer time and interact with you more.

As a viewer, you may contribute the Snacks by gifting and sending Snacks.

records.text: The off day will be automatically applied on the day streamers don't livestream, and when streamers start livestreaming during such days, it will not be counted as their Off Day.

records.name: snack_rank_desc_1
records.text: 獲得したグレードポイント:

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: 「グレード」は、ライバーを応援する画期的なシステムに導入されている、ライバーの報酬ステータスを示しています。リスナーと交流を深めるだけでなく、同じグレードにいるライバーと競いながらも楽しくグレードアップを目指せます。グレードアップすると、配信スコアや時給がアップします。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: ライバーは、1日のエール獲得やリスナーとの交流状況に応じて、同じグレードにいる他のライバーと競いながら応援スコアを積み上げるか、ライバーのグレードによっては、予め定められた応援スコアの閾値に到達することで、グレードが変動します。グレードポイントが「+2」になるとグレードアップ、「-3」になるとグレードダウンとなります。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
ライバーは、リスナーにできるだけ長く配信を視聴してもらい、積極的に交流するよう促しましょう。

リスナーは、ギフトやエールを贈ることでライバーの応援スコアの獲得に貢献することができます。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1
records.text: 17LIVEは、健全で快適な配信環境を提供することに努めており、ライバーは毎日の生活リズムに合わせて配信を行うことができます。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.2
records.text: 配信が行われない日は、自動的にオフデーが使用されます。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.3
records.text: 配信後、オフデーを使用することも可能です。使用した場合、配信にて獲得した応援スコアは、グレードスコア計算の対象外となり、 グレード評価も行われません。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.4
records.text: 毎月 %s 日分のオフデーが付与されます。オフデーの有効期限は、付与された月の末日となり、翌月以降に繰越ことはできません。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_note

records.name: superfan_instruction_des
records.text: 「スーパーサポーターレベル」は、17LIVEのすべてのリスナーを対象に付きます。リスナーは、エールを贈ると、エールポイント以外にサポーターポイントも上がります。サポーターポイントに応じてスーパーサポーターレベルが上がっていき、ライバーのエールランクにも反映されます。あなたもスーパーサポーターレベルのアップを目指しましょう！

records.name: superfan_instruction_des_1
records.text: ライバーにエールを送ると、サポーターポイントが付きます。サポーターポイントが貯まると、スーパーサポーターとしてのレベルが上がり、特別なスーパーサポーターバッジがもらえます。レベルアップに連れて、エールを贈ることでもらえるサポーターポイントが増えます。ライバーにとってもエールポイントが増えるので、応援に繋がります。

records.name: superfan_instruction_des_1_1
records.text: スーパーサポーターレベルが高いほど、あなたが贈るエールポイントもパワーアップします。

records.name: superfan_instruction_des_1_subtitle
records.text: サポーターレベルの上げ方

records.name: superfan_instruction_des_2
records.text: 一人のライバーに一日7つのエールを贈る「フルエール」で、サポーターポイントが増えます。またライバーのランクやレベニューシェアの％も上がります。

records.name: superfan_instruction_des_2_1
records.text: フルエールを贈った後、ライバーのエールポイントが増えるだけでなく、当日のスーパーサポーターポイントの減少が停止します。エールをたくさん贈って、ライバーを応援しましょう。

records.name: superfan_instruction_des_2_subdes_1
records.text: 次のエールを贈れるようになるまで待機する時間がありますが、コメントすることでこの待機時間を短縮することができます。

records.name: vip_membership_page_intro_content
records.text:
プレミアムメンバーとは？ 
月間VIPチャージご利用額に応じて、特別な特典やプライズをお使い頂けるサービスです。

ご自身の利用状況を確認しながら、プライズの獲得、プロモーションを活用することができます。
またプレミアムメンバー限定のイベントも開催されますので、どうぞお見逃しなく！

ルール：
このサービスは、毎月更新されるため、各月1日にプレミアムメンバーのステータスなどがリセットされます。
当ルールは、ユーザーの登録地域によって異なる場合があります。
詳細については、登録地域の「プレミアムメンバーについて」をご覧ください。

17LIVEは、当ルールの最終的な決定と解釈に関わる権利を有します。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1
records.text: Never will you run out of things to talk about! Upon request, AI Assistant will always provide fresh topics ideas to keep your livestreams engaging.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_2
records.text: Staying well-informed and up-to-date, AI Assistant offers suggestions tailored to your real-time chat and what's trending.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_3
records.text: See a topic you like? Long-press to post it to your stream, sharing with your audience and get the conversation going.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_1
records.text: Tired of missing chats? AI Auto Engagement greets viewers, thanks for gifts, & sparks chats. It answers simple questions too!

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_2
records.text: Your AI, your rules! Customize how your Auto Engagement assistant talks & replies. Make it your personalized stream sidekick!

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_3
records.text: Your feedback guide AI's growth. Share your experience with us anytime. Let's make it an even better sidekick for your stream together.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_1
records.text: Spice up streams with Interactive Games! Play Draw & Guess and Quiz Game with viewers. AI handles everything: rules, hints, answers. Just have fun with your community.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_2
records.text: No more dead air! AI analyzes stream vibe and suggests perfect topics to keep viewers hooked & chat buzzing!. When chat slows, it will prompt new topics - hands-free! You can also set topic themes to guide AI.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_3
records.text: AI greets new viewers, thanks supporters, encourages gifts, & chats in comments. Focus on content, AI handles engagement! Boost loyalty, save time!

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: Snack Rank is a new growth system for streamers to engage with their viewers and also enjoy the healthy competition with other streamers in the same rank. Streamers can get higher hourly wage and achievement scores as their Snack Rank is increased.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: Based on the Snacks the streamer receives on the day, they will either compete with other streamers or meet the minimum Snack threshold to get the Rank Point. By achieving +2 Rank Points to rank up and hitting -3 Rank Points will rank down.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
As a streamer, encourage your viewers to stay with you for a longer time and interact with you more.

As a viewer, you may contribute the Snacks by gifting and sending Snacks.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1
records.text: We are committed to building a safe and welcoming environment for everyone to enjoy livestreams. We encourage streamers to start livestreams based on their own habits and schedules, which allows more flexibility and creates more balance for you.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.2
records.text: The off day will be automatically applied on the day streamers don't livestream, and when streamers start livestreaming during such days, it will not be counted as their Off Day.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.3
records.text: After the broadcast starts, the Liver can still choose whether to use the off day that day. Once used, the Liver won't join the finalization on that day and the used day cannot be canceled.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.4
records.text: Each streamer enjoy %s Off Days every month, and the unused days will expire on the last day of each month.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1
records.text: Never will you run out of things to talk about! Upon request, AI Assistant will always provide fresh topics ideas to keep your livestreams engaging.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_2
records.text: Staying well-informed and up-to-date, AI Assistant offers suggestions tailored to your real-time chat and what's trending.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_3
records.text: See a topic you like? Long-press to post it to your stream, sharing with your audience and get the conversation going.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_1
records.text: Tired of missing chats? AI Auto Engagement greets viewers, thanks for gifts, & sparks chats. It answers simple questions too!

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_2
records.text: Your AI, your rules! Customize how your Auto Engagement assistant talks & replies. Make it your personalized stream sidekick!

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_3
records.text: Your feedback guide AI's growth. Share your experience with us anytime. Let's make it an even better sidekick for your stream together.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_1
records.text: Spice up streams with Interactive Games! Play Draw & Guess and Quiz Game with viewers. AI handles everything: rules, hints, answers. Just have fun with your community.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_2
records.text: No more dead air! AI analyzes stream vibe and suggests perfect topics to keep viewers hooked & chat buzzing!. When chat slows, it will prompt new topics - hands-free! You can also set topic themes to guide AI.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_3
records.text: AI greets new viewers, thanks supporters, encourages gifts, & chats in comments. Focus on content, AI handles engagement! Boost loyalty, save time!

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: Snack Rank is a new growth system for streamers to engage with their viewers and also enjoy the healthy competition with other streamers in the same rank. Streamers can get higher hourly wage and achievement scores as their Snack Rank is increased.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: Based on the Snacks the streamer receives on the day, they will either compete with other streamers or meet the minimum Snack threshold to get the Rank Point. By achieving +2 Rank Points to rank up and hitting -3 Rank Points will rank down.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
As a streamer, encourage your viewers to stay with you for a longer time and interact with you more.

As a viewer, you may contribute the Snacks by gifting and sending Snacks.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1
records.text: We are committed to building a safe and welcoming environment for everyone to enjoy livestreams. We encourage streamers to start livestreams based on their own habits and schedules, which allows more flexibility and creates more balance for you.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.2
records.text: The off day will be automatically applied on the day streamers don't livestream, and when streamers start livestreaming during such days, it will not be counted as their Off Day.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.3

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: Snack Rank is a new growth system for streamers to engage with their viewers and also enjoy the healthy competition with other streamers in the same rank. Streamers can get higher hourly wage and achievement scores as their Snack Rank is increased.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: Based on the Snacks the streamer receives on the day, they will either compete with other streamers or meet the minimum Snack threshold to get the Rank Point. By achieving +2 Rank Points to rank up and hitting -3 Rank Points will rank down.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
As a streamer, encourage your viewers to stay with you for a longer time and interact with you more.

As a viewer, you may contribute the Snacks by gifting and sending Snacks.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1
records.text: We are committed to building a safe and welcoming environment for everyone to enjoy livestreams. We encourage streamers to start livestreams based on their own habits and schedules, which allows more flexibility and creates more balance for you.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.2
records.text: The off day will be automatically applied on the day streamers don't livestream, and when streamers start livestreaming during such days, it will not be counted as their Off Day.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.3
records.text: After the broadcast starts, the Liver can still choose whether to use the off day that day. Once used, the Liver won't join the finalization on that day and the used day cannot be canceled.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.4
records.text: Each streamer enjoy %s Off Days every month, and the unused days will expire on the last day of each month.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_note
records.text: Note: 17LIVE reserves the right of the explanation of the Snack delivery mechanism.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: 點心等級是為主播量身打造的新成長系統，讓主播得以與觀眾互動的同時享受與其他主播良性競爭的樂趣。主播在點心等級成長後，可以獲得較高的時薪以及成就值。

records.text: 根據主播當日收到的點心，主播可以參與與其他主播的競賽，也可以達成點心最低門檻以取得等級點數。取得「+2」等級點數即可升級；若等級點數為「-3」則等級會降低。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
主播可以鼓勵觀眾在直播間待久一些並且進行互動。

觀眾可以透過送禮、評論、送出點心或是看播以支持主播。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1
records.text: 17LIVE 致力於打造安全且舒適的直播環境，因此我們鼓勵主播依據自己的習慣以及行程安排直播排程，以享有更多彈性並且取得工作與生活之間的平衡。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.2
records.text: 休息日會在主播沒有直播當天自動啟用；若主播當天有開播，則該日不會被判定為休息日。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.3
records.text: 開播後，主播仍可選擇是否使用休息日。一旦選擇使用後，當日的直播便不會計入當日結算，休息日的次數也無法返還。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.4
records.text: 主播每月享有%s天的休息日，而當月未使用完的休息日會在月底失效。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1
records.text: 不必再擔心沒有話題聊！只要向 AI 助理提出要求，它就會幫你想出各種聊天主題，炒熱直播間的氣氛。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_2
records.text: AI 助理緊跟時事及直播間動態，可以從直播間正在討論的內容或是流行趨勢推薦聊天話題。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_3
records.text: 發現想聊的話題了嗎？長按該話題並且貼到直播間，就可以開始和觀眾從天南聊到地北！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_1
records.text: 還在煩惱錯過聊天訊息嗎？AI 自動互動功能會向觀眾打招呼、感謝禮物，並開啟話題。它還能回答簡單的問題喔！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_2
records.text: 你的 AI，你說了算！自訂你的自動互動助手說話和回覆的方式。讓它成為你個人化的直播助手！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_3
records.text: 你的回饋引導 AI 成長。隨時與我們分享你的使用體驗。讓我們一起讓它成為你直播更棒的助手吧。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_1
records.text: 用互動遊戲為直播增添樂趣！和觀眾一起玩「你畫我猜」和「問答遊戲」。AI 處理所有事項：規則、提示、答案。盡情和你的社群同樂吧！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_2
records.text: 不再有冷場！AI 分析直播氛圍，並建議聊天話題，讓觀眾保持興趣，群聊熱絡不間斷！當聊天速度減慢時，它會自動提示新話題 - 完全免手動！你也可以設定話題主題來引導 AI。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_3
records.text: AI 會向新觀眾打招呼、感謝支持者、鼓勵送禮，並在留言區聊天。專注於內容，AI 處理互動！提升忠誠度，節省時間！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1
records.text: 不必再担心没有话题聊！只要向 AI 助理提出要求，它就会帮你想出各种聊天主题，炒热直播间的气氛。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_2
records.text: AI 助理紧跟时事及直播间动态，可以从直播间正在讨论的内容或是流行趋势推荐聊天话题。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_3
records.text: 发现想聊的话题了吗？长按该话题并且贴到直播间，就可以开始和观众从天南聊到地北！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_1
records.text: 还在烦恼错过聊天讯息吗？ AI 自动互动功能会向观众打招呼、感谢礼物，并开启话题。它还能回答简单的问题喔！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_2
records.text: 你的 AI，你说了算！自订你的自动互动助手说话和回覆的方式。让它成为你个人化的直播助手！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_3
records.text: 你的回馈引导 AI 成长。随时与我们分享你的使用体验。让我们一起让它成为你直播更棒的助手吧。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_1
records.text: 用互动游戏为直播增添乐趣！和观众一起玩「你画我猜」和「问答游戏」。 AI 处理所有事项：规则、提示、答案。尽情和你的社群同乐吧！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_2
records.text: 不再有冷场！ AI 分析直播氛围，并建议聊天话题，让观众保持兴趣，群聊热络不间断！当聊天速度减慢时，它会自动提示新话题 - 完全免手动！你也可以设定话题主题来引导 AI。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_3
records.text: AI 会向新观众打招呼、感谢支持者、鼓励送礼，并在留言区聊天。专注于内容，AI 处理互动！提升忠诚度，节省时间！

records.text: 點心等級是為主播量身打造的新成長系統，讓主播得以與觀眾互動的同時享受與其他主播良性競爭的樂趣。主播在點心等級成長後，可以獲得較高的時薪以及成就值。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1
records.text: 不必再擔心沒有話題聊！只要向 AI 助理提出要求，它就會幫你想出各種聊天主題，炒熱直播間的氣氛。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_2
records.text: AI 助理緊跟時事及直播間動態，可以從直播間正在討論的內容或是流行趨勢推薦聊天話題。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_3
records.text: 發現想聊的話題了嗎？長按該話題並且貼到直播間，就可以開始和觀眾從天南聊到地北！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_1
records.text: 還在煩惱錯過聊天訊息嗎？AI 自動互動功能會向觀眾打招呼、感謝禮物，並開啟話題。它還能回答簡單的問題喔！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_2
records.text: 你的 AI，你說了算！自訂你的自動互動助手說話和回覆的方式。讓它成為你個人化的直播助手！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_3
records.text: 你的回饋引導 AI 成長。隨時與我們分享你的使用體驗。讓我們一起讓它成為你直播更棒的助手吧。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_1
records.text: 用互動遊戲為直播增添樂趣！和觀眾一起玩「你畫我猜」和「問答遊戲」。AI 處理所有事項：規則、提示、答案。盡情和你的社群同樂吧！

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_2
records.text: 不再有冷場！AI 分析直播氛圍，並建議聊天話題，讓觀眾保持興趣，群聊熱絡不間斷！當聊天速度減慢時，它會自動提示新話題 - 完全免手動！你也可以設定話題主題來引導 AI。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_3
records.text: AI 會向新觀眾打招呼、感謝支持者、鼓勵送禮，並在留言區聊天。專注於內容，AI 處理互動！提升忠誠度，節省時間！

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: 點心等級是為主播量身打造的新成長系統，讓主播得以與觀眾互動的同時享受與其他主播良性競爭的樂趣。主播在點心等級成長後，可以獲得較高的時薪以及成就值。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
主播可以鼓勵觀眾在直播間待久一些並且進行互動。

觀眾可以透過送禮、評論、送出點心或是看播以支持主播。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1
records.text: 17LIVE 致力於打造安全且舒適的直播環境，因此我們鼓勵主播依據自己的習慣以及行程安排直播排程，以享有更多彈性並且取得工作與生活之間的平衡。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.2
records.text: 休息日會在主播沒有直播當天自動啟用；若主播當天有開播，則該日不會被判定為休息日。

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.3
records.text: 開播後，主播仍可選擇是否使用休息日。一旦選擇使用後，當日的直播便不會計入當日結算，休息日的次數也無法返還。

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_1
records.text: Never will you run out of things to talk about! Upon request, AI Assistant will always provide fresh topics ideas to keep your livestreams engaging.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_2
records.text: Staying well-informed and up-to-date, AI Assistant offers suggestions tailored to your real-time chat and what's trending.

records.text: Your AI, your rules! Customize how your Auto Engagement assistant talks & replies. Make it your personalized stream sidekick!

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v2_3
records.text: Your feedback guide AI's growth. Share your experience with us anytime. Let's make it an even better sidekick for your stream together.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_1
records.text: Spice up streams with Interactive Games! Play Draw & Guess and Quiz Game with viewers. AI handles everything: rules, hints, answers. Just have fun with your community.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_2
records.text: No more dead air! AI analyzes stream vibe and suggests perfect topics to keep viewers hooked & chat buzzing!. When chat slows, it will prompt new topics - hands-free! You can also set topic themes to guide AI.

records.name: ai_assistant_tutorial_desc_v3_3
records.text: AI greets new viewers, thanks supporters, encourages gifts, & chats in comments. Focus on content, AI handles engagement! Boost loyalty, save time!

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: Snack Rank is a new growth system for streamers to engage with their viewers and also enjoy the healthy competition with other streamers in the same rank. Streamers can get higher hourly wage and achievement scores as their Snack Rank is increased.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: Based on the Snacks the streamer receives on the day, they will either compete with other streamers or meet the minimum Snack threshold to get the Rank Point. By achieving +2 Rank Points to rank up and hitting -3 Rank Points will rank down.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_3
records.text:
As a streamer, encourage your viewers to stay with you for a longer time and interact with you more.

As a viewer, you may contribute the Snacks by gifting and sending Snacks.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_4.1

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_1
records.text: Snack Rank is a new growth system for streamers to engage with their viewers and also enjoy the healthy competition with other streamers in the same rank. Streamers can get higher hourly wage and achievement scores as their Snack Rank is increased.

records.name: snack_rank_faq_des_2
records.text: Based on the Snacks the streamer receives on the day, they will either compete with other streamers or meet the minimum Snack threshold to get the Rank Point. By achieving +2 Rank Points to rank up and hitting -3 Rank Points will rank down.

records.text:
As a streamer, encourage your viewers to stay with you for a longer time and interact with you more.

As a viewer, you may contribute the Snacks by gifting and sending Snacks.

records.text:
What is a VIP Membership?
With a VIP membership, you can earn rewards, participate in VIP exclusive events, and gain special access to promotions and other services.

Rules:
Membership requires a monthly renewal, and your membership status resets on the 1st of each month. Rules may vary across regions. Please refer to the membership details for your region, which you can access by tapping on the "?" icon on the "Program Overview" page. 

Disclosure: 
17LIVE reserves the right to make final decisions and interpret rules.
